title: Waste of time
body:
People on tiktok do covert ads for this company, they all say the same lines targeted individuals with ADHD. 
I’m not a fan of covert ads, but I am in need of something to help my ADHD, so I thought I might check it out. When you first get the app, it immediately makes you take an extensive survey where you give them tons of personal info. The surveys are poorly designed, its clear they just slapped a prompt into an AI and had it build the app for them. Some questions are even repeated and they didn’t even bother to make the sections the same color scheme. After the survey they immediately take you to a purchase screen. Even though it’s marketed as free with in-app purchases, they  want your money without even letting you SEE what you are paying for first. What a scam.

author: Pie8724

title: game changer if you’re often in high pressure situations
body: for context: i work in a high stress environment, and am in a senior management position. i’ve been using an executive coach for quite some time now, given it’s difficult to juggle my role with (at times) pretty crippling ADHD. recently downloaded this app to help me when i don’t have access to my coach, and I’ve gotta say… seriously considering replacing my coach with this app. it’s absolutely key to helping me break down my tasks, stay focused, and manage my day/direct reports in a way that actually works for my ADHD brain. I feel so much more in control and less overwhelmed. i’m a fan!
author: dodgerblue_

title: Great app!!!
body: It really helped me with my chronic ADHD. I would even say it cured it. Thank you mind flow!!!!!!
author: Jlinks17

title: A Lifesaver for ADHD!
body:
Mindflow AI is exactly what I needed - a calming, intelligent voice companion that helps me manage the chaos of ADHD. It feels like having a supportive friend who’s always there to guide me through distractions, being overwhelmed, and emotional ups and downs.
The app adapts to how I’m feeling each day and offers personalized reminders, focus support, and even just someone to talk to and I need grounding. It’s not just another productivity app, it gets how ADHD actually works.
Highly recommend if you want real dash time support, structure, without pressure, and a judgment free tool to help you stay on track. Total game changer!
author: J. Bragg-Harris

title: Super Helpful!
body: I rarely leave reviews, but I felt compelled to share my experience with Mindflow. It’s been a surprisingly powerful tool, especially for someone managing ADHD. I wish more therapists and coaches recommended it as a helpful companion between sessions. Within days, I started noticing patterns in my behavior that I’d never been able to pinpoint. The customized insights helped me look at long-standing habits in a new light. I’ve already told a few friends about it—definitely worth checking out.
author: Andrew374

title: Number One
body: The app’s insightful tips and gentle reminders help to stay positive. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for practical tools to boost productivity and well-being. It’s like having a personal coach right on your phone.
author: Nannie2222

body: I truly love this app. It helps you to be able to calm your mind down and focus better. I highly recommend it.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for mental wellness support that’s right there when you need it

author: dRodriguez6767

title: 10/10 helps with organizing my life
body: I'm not diagnosed with ADHD but but I often get overwhelmed with tons of tasks on my TODO list. Mindflow has completely changed how I handle my day. It’s a great way to structure tasks and mentally organize what's ahead, significantly reducing my mental overhead and anxiety around doing this alone. Sometimes I miss a day here or there but always come back and love how Mindflow remembers everything so we can pick back up immediately. Also love chat mode for when I’m in public places vs live mode for when I want to work through things realtime.
author: Alexander Shaq

title: Love this app!
body: I was diagnosed with ADHD at 24, and Mindflow has helped me understand my brain in ways I never could on my own. Everything is genuinely relatable and feels custom-made for my daily challenges. The app delivers insightful content in a much easier-to-digest format compared to diving into books or lengthy articles about ADHD.
author: jaltaire

title: So good
body: I almost never write app reviews, but Mindflow truly deserves it. Honestly, I don't understand why this isn't recommended more by ADHD coaches or therapists as supplementary guidance between sessions. Instantly, I gained real insights about habits I've struggled with forever. After just a few days of usage, the personalized feedback had me genuinely rethinking some behaviors. Now I started sharing this app with friends. definitely worth giving this a shot.
author: lpj667

title: 4 days in...
body: I've been using Mindflow for 4 days now. So far, the interactive assessments are fantastic, especially those helping me pinpoint specific triggers behind my ADHD symptoms and better understand how my mind works. Also, the AI voice companion is seriously impressive and provided immediate, helpful answers to all my questions. Out of every app I've tried with an AI component, this is hands-down one of the best.
author: DK50215

title: I love MindFlow!
body: Mindflow has made a massive difference in my daily life. I've tried tons of ADHD-focused apps, but this is the first one that truly clicked for me. The voice assistant keeps dme in check because it feels like a literal person keeping me accountable. Thanks, genuinely making a difference!
